page.content:
Expert-reviewed free encyclopedia that Wikipedia was meant to feed.

How Nupedia connects

  • Character: Larry Sanger — Sanger was editor-in-chief of Nupedia.
  • Topic: Wikipedia — Nupedia preceded Wikipedia and was meant to receive its drafts.
  • Character: Jimmy Wales — Wales funded Nupedia through Bomis as a free expert encyclopedia.
  • Topic: Wikipedia — Wikipedia overtook and outlived the Nupedia review process.
  • Faction: Bomis — Bomis paid for Nupedia's early staff and hosting.

What is Nupedia?

Nupedia (2000–03) used a seven-step expert review. It published only a few dozen finished articles while Wikipedia, started as its draft space, grew past it.

Key threads lead to Larry Sanger, Wikipedia, Jimmy Wales, Wikipedia and Bomis.
